exclusions.title: Native Go client
exclusions.reason: The native typed and raw Go HTTP clients were deliberately removed; applications use the JavaScript clients, direct Go API, or ordinary HTTP routes.

exclusions.title: JavaScript client
exclusions.reason: The separately tested clients/ package is an ecosystem artifact and is intentionally not counted as a native Go capability.

exclusions.title: JavaScript framework integrations
exclusions.reason: React, Next.js, Vue, and Solid ship from the separately tested clients/ package; other framework integrations remain deferred and none are counted in the native Go graph.

exclusions.title: TypeScript compiler and declaration contracts
exclusions.reason: TypeScript inference and diagnostic behavior has no direct Go runtime equivalent.

exclusions.title: JavaScript runtime matrix
exclusions.reason: The clients/ package has its own Bun gates; Node.js, Deno, Cloudflare Workers, Vite, esbuild, and Playwright matrices are not native Go capabilities.

exclusions.title: TypeScript ORM adapters
exclusions.reason: Drizzle, Prisma, and Kysely are replaced by native Go storage adapters and shared storage contracts.

exclusions.title: Billing and payment integrations
exclusions.reason: Stripe, Polar billing, Creem, Dodo Payments, Autumn, and related billing plugins were explicitly removed from scope.

exclusions.title: Polar OAuth provider
exclusions.reason: The provider was explicitly removed from the supported provider registry.

exclusions.title: Product command-line interface
exclusions.reason: The application CLI was explicitly removed; developer-only Go conformance commands are not shipped as product API.

exclusions.title: Anonymous product telemetry
exclusions.reason: The standalone telemetry publisher and its configuration surface were explicitly removed; tracing instrumentation and application logging remain supported.
